experiment.model: Synthetic central narrow-band envelopes, simultaneous noisy off-band reference where qualified by construction, matched signal-free calibration backgrounds. Not real radio spectrograms. Independent noise AR(1) rho .35, common AR(1) rho .75, nonuniform gains and per-view variances in hetero regime. Equal unit signal response, externally aligned views; no hidden signal parameters in inference.

methods.R15A: Frozen bank and thresholds from parent receipt, plain mean; descriptive historical comparator.
methods.EQ: Plain mean with new matched per-regime null calibration; fair primary comparator.
methods.GLS: Shrinkage covariance of signal-free background only, inverse covariance weighting w=C^-1 1/(1^T C^-1 1).
methods.REF: Off-band regression coefficient estimated using background only; subtract measured reference variation with fixed response calibration; equal mean.
methods.FULL: Qualified reference subtraction + GLS + symmetric AR(1) temporal precision matched-template score. Unqualified reference ignored, no fitted event regression. Separate ablations GLS and REF; compare with EQ on identical inputs.
methods.calibration: Same null generator for all methods; bins observed E [0,4,8,16,32,64,128,256], per regime and view count and algorithm, 97.5 percentile higher, min 60, unsupported abstain. Frozen lock before eval, no label-guided routing. Stress uses HETERO_COMMON_REF lock with no re-fit thresholds.
methods.mirror: Reverse event AND background AND reference in time; weights and rho invariant; D sign flips and E invariant; input hashes preserved.
methods.identifiability: If signal and noise are both a(t)*ones, observations have exactly identical likelihood under exchanged decomposition; no method can separate without independent information. Construct exact paired example; never promote carrier.

gates.primary: At 8 views HETERO_COMMON_REF, per seed FULL weak correct >= EQ+10 percentage points, weak wrong <=5%, pooled null declarations <=5%, strong correct >=85%, no paired strong hit lost relative to EQ. All seeds must pass. Matched calibration budgets; report exact counts and null breakdown.
gates.protection: IID and ALIGNED_COMMON_NO_REF per seed at 8: FULL weak correct not more than 5 percentage points below EQ, null <=5%, zero paired strong losses, strong coverage >=85%. No expectation of recovering nonidentifiable common signal.
gates.stress: For each stress type 8 views: null declarations <=5%, weak wrong <=5%, strong >=85%, no new strong losses vs EQ; report HOLD on fail.
gates.reconstruction: Frozen R15 reconstructor on raw equal-mean 8-view IID double/clipped cases, compare R14 and linear; no selector change; double median <= both, clipped diagnostic. Do not let shadow scores erase candidates.

scientific_ceiling: No real independent radio measurement, no calibrated exotic carrier response, no UAP linkage, no external blind exam. Morphology only; production unchanged. 5D canonical axes, preserve failed gates and all ordinary alternatives.
